svg.title: RheoBoardOTS DIY — Fritzing-style wiring
svg.desc: RheoBoardOTS DIY component wiring illustration, CC BY-SA 4.0. Component artwork: SparkFun Fritzing_Parts (ESP32 Thing Plus); Adafruit Fritzing-Library (PCA9685 product 815); Florian Schäffer, modified by vanepp August 2022 (L298N); Fritzing (mini breadboard). Other component illustrations are photo-based. Artwork was arranged, scaled and rotated, driver jumper caps were added, and wiring and labels were drawn for RheoBoardOTS. Source links and original license notices: https://github.com/The-Hybrid-Atelier/RheoBoard/tree/main/BuildYourOwn/RheoBoardOTS/hardware/electronic-wiring#artwork-credits . License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ .
